notes.title: The 2025 Update! Adding Steam Deck Support!
notes.content: [p]It’s been a while since we had a Verdant Skies update, and this has turned out to be a big one![/p][p]There were two big goals with this update- finish up full controller support for the Steam Deck and to keep the game running on modern systems by updating the underlying engine. These two items turned out to be a fair bit of work![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31065354/fe5c6030307c6c69caac6a9ffe0b324f6feddf2f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I’m a firm believer in keeping a game working as long as possible. I want Verdant Skies to be a game you can come back to years later. You should be able to reinstall it 10 years later and play it with your kids.[/p][p]Fortunately, Verdant Skies has been very stable on both Windows and Linux through the years, but I wanted to update the game ahead of compatibility problems. This meant upgrading the game from Unity 2017 to 2019.4.39… then to 2020.3.40, then 2021.3.11, then through several point releases up to 2021.3.55f1, which, despite the confusing name, was released on Aug 5, 2025.[/p][p][/p][h2]Steam Deck Verification[/h2][p]Steam Deck Verification was another big goal for this update. We already had great native Linux support, and our performance was carefully managed, so it ran quite well on the console. But the Steam Deck is very strict about being able to access the entire game with the controllers. So I redid a ton of UIs. I found I needed to rework many of them entirely to make them easier to navigate with the controller. I also added controller-specific navigation tips, better arrows to indicate which button is focused, etc. Verdant Skies contains about 103 distinct UI windows, from the [i]AlarmClockUI[/i] to [i]WoodStainSelectionUI[/i]. So this was a huge amount of work.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31065354/5d425dfde01317c81b2eb1d9c2eef6de3ef5beed.png"][/img][/p][p]Virtual keyboard support was another early pain-point. There’s only a handful of places in Verdant Skies where you can enter text, but a lot of games get by without any. But I believe naming yourself, your colonists, and your animals is really important to the vision of the game. For best accessibility, I use the system UIs for virtual keyboards - on Steam Deck, that means Steam’s popup keyboard.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31065354/497c1607e0f5bff1b04775c4f1bb1e909dd9f52a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I upgraded Rewired, the code library we use for controller support several times during this update. If you’re a controller user, you’ll find better rebinding support and a lot more hints that show the actual controller button in-game.[/p][p][/p][h2]It's a big project![/h2][p]Since the last pushed public update in April of 2021, there has been 203 commits to the project! That included 2 WWise upgrades (our audio and music engine), 2 Rewired upgrades, and a total of about 8 Unity engine upgrades. Internally, I brought forward a bunch of process / build / workflow tools from other projects. This gave us a drastic improvement to build times and launch times, and makes our deployment process more reliable.[/p][p][/p][h2]Podcast Interview[/h2][p]If you’d like to hear more about this update and my experiences revisiting the Verdant Skies codebase, check out this [url="https://nicegames.club/episode/402"]Nice Games Club[/url] podcast episode![/p][list][*][p][url="https://nicegames.club/episode/402"]Andy Korth - Revisiting Your Games - Episode 402[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31065354/9148db4461902213b25c7b18490a2abb021e8e6f.png"][/img][/p][h1]Veridian Expanse![/h1][p]Our next game, [url="https://veridianexpanse.com/"]Veridian Expanse[/url], has been in development for a while now. Although it’s a different genre of game, it canonically takes place in the same universe as Verdant Skies, so there is some fun cross-over lore. You can [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137670/Veridian_Expanse/"]Wishlist it on Steam[/url] today, and we’d be very appreciative![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="VT6nIj66dic;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Verdant Skies: Summer Modding Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We're happy to share the Verdant Skies Summer Modding update. Version 1.4.0 has a lot of new features, with some especially exciting ones people who like playing with mods and making them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/2c4121497ee7bfeae6605331bd19d1f677cf1914.jpg[/img]

[b]Major Items:[/b]
[list]
    [*] The Mod Uploader tool is now built into the game, making it easier than ever to share your mod. 
    [*] Create and view waypoints for custom dialog events, schedules, and more.
    [*] A large amount of documentation for modding has been added to the wiki!
    [*] Rework character events for Sasha, Yuki, Rosie, Wyatt, and Miles. These characters have a few flirting questions, and won't confess their love to you unless you hint pretty strongly that you're interested. If you don't hint to them, you'll have the option to confess to them.
[/list]

[img][/img]

[b]Full changelog:[/b]
[list]
    [*] More changes to support stranger aspect ratios.
    [*] Intro now has an animated starfield. This might help with a few people who got stuck on black screens on the intro.
    [*] Redo the mod list to better show mod information.
    [*] Modders can use the "talkTo" element when defining event triggers to specify which person's friendship is checked with minFriendship.
    [*] Better logging for potential audio engine issues.
    [*] Minor typo fixes and text improvements, like telling you which inventory is full when you get seeds.
    [*] Add a dropdown list to choose your resolution.
    [*] Yuki fan art dialog added.
    [*] Lots of new Yuki daily dialog if you've had a commitment ceremony with her.
    [*] Clean up save file format- it's now easier to browse and debug.
    [*] Save files track which mods were used in their creation. It will warn you if you've loaded a save and might not have the correct mods.
    [*] Ratchet up the compression quality on a few assets.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Items mounted on bookcases, etc sometimes would end up on the floor until you re-entered your house. This is fixed.
    [*]Fix Miles' shipping quest value calculation being off by one.
    [*]Fix typo in Rosie's marsh boots dialog and Jade's 4th heart event.
    [*]Mouseover icon could sometimes be incorrect if you're the keyboard and mouse at the same time.
    [*]Wyatt now gets a big bed, just like everyone else.
    [*]Sometimes greyed out buttons wouldn't highlight. This is fixed now.
    [*]Some waypoints were incorrect in Wyatt's 8th heart event.
    [*]Prevent a weird case where you could move items during the shipping animation and lose them.
    [*]Fix the JumpIfOutdoors modding command.
    [*]Fix an issue where baby rename events might happen even if you don't have a baby with that person (save migration issue prior to 1.3.0).
[/list]

notes.title: Verdant Skies 1.3.2 - Character Customizer Fix!
notes.content:
Verdant Skies 1.3.2 went live last night. Most notably it contains a fix to a pretty big usability issue with the character customizer. This bug prevented newly created characters from changing the selected item of clothing without a few extra clicks. Version 1.3.0 included a major interface rewrite and got a lot of testing as a result. Unfortunately, this bug was introduced late in the 1.3.0 release cycle after the testing had uncovered some controller issues. Those fixes introduced the character customizer control issue. It also only occurred for new players, since they didn't have clothing items written to their save file yet, which made it a bit harder to find the bug via normal testing. I'm very sorry for the inconvenience caused by this issue! Thanks to everyone who reported it and described the issue. It's a huge help in finding and fixing bugs!

Full change list:
[list] 
[*] A major usability issue with the character customizer was fixed.
[*] Teleporter and Teleporter Remote moved to correct crafting UI.
[*] Energy Bar width displayed incorrectly after increasing your max energy.
[*] Skye's tripod outside her home can no longer be stolen
[*] Minor event tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Verdant Skies 1.2: The Storage Update and our first sale!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce Verdant Skies 1.2: The Storage Update! This new content update focuses on several different storage related improvements (plus some other goodies, of course!). A new storage box can be constructed very cheaply, and you can place as many as you need to store your goodies. But that's not all; a new collection shop contains all the cosmetic items you've ever unlocked. So you can repurchase items you've lost, sold, or been unable to store. Or maybe you just really want 15 mannequins for your house. 
	
	To help with seed and animal DNA storage, the transgenic splicer upgrade allows you to combine different species of crops and animal samples. If you're trying to upgrade multiple seeds, this really reduces the number of seeds you need to keep in storage. We've also added seed labels, which let you keep track of your favorite combinations at a glance! The labels show up on the crops grown with the seeds too! 
	
	Finally, now that we've been our for three months, we're starting our first sale! We're participating in a weeklong deal, and Verdant Skies will be 33% off for a week- starting now.


New in version 1.2.0:

[B]New Content:[/B]
[list]
    [*] New storage container with unique contents. Build as many as you need!
    [*] Seed labels! Customize your seed packets in your inventory with custom icons so you know which seed is which. You can assign icons by placing seeds in the output area of the splicer.
    [*] Collection Shop! Repurchase the cosmetic items unlocked when you completed someone's collection. The shop unlocks when you have Miles and Nessa's second event and enter Miles' house.
    [*] Transgenic Splicer: unlock the ability to combine genes across species. Visit Zaheen after you've had their 3rd heart event and unlocked Nessa to start this quest chain.
	[*] New eclipse party event after you've unlocked every character.
[/list]

[B]New Features:[/B]
[list]
    [*] All weddings have some camera animations.
    [*] Chairs can now be rotated to all four directions.
    [*] Dramatic improvements to hose and leash rendering.
    [*] Big improvements to controller support in character editor. Improve controller focus visibility.
    [*] Added new hardware cursor, enabled by default.
    [*] All buildings have matching colors, so you can make your house match now. You'll need to recolor your home.
    [*] Night isn't quite as dark, sky looks better, and color correction improvements.
    [*] Improved clickable regions for various rocks and scrap.
    [*] Lunch events now restore some of your energy.
    [*] New options screen.
    [*] Balance tweaks to craftables. Circuit boards faster and reorganized some objects.
    [*] Tree lamp can be placed on tables, items can be placed on the display shelves.
    [*] Animals can be brought inside your home now, but not into NPC homes.
    [*] Frogs can no longer walk on water.
[/list]

[B]Fixes:[/B]
[list]
	[*] Big fix to how animals save their timers and progress towards next product.
    [*] Fix issue with releasing an animal while you have a different one on a leash.
	[*] Fix resolution issues with the new Surface Pro.
	[*] Fix oddities when trying to move items while the shipping box is animated.
	[*] Fixed an issue where the incubator shadow wouldn't be visible.
    [*] New vertex shader to eliminate seams on walls that show up on some computers but not others.
    [*] Fix launching issue on OS X 10.10.x by disabling steam overlay on those machines.
    [*] Fix issue with collider of the small bed.
    [*] Fix error when you deconstruct one watering hose while holding a different hose.
    [*] Fix bug when passing out while you have an animal.
    [*] Prevent creative use of beds that allow players to escape the map.
    [*] Water effects are more consistent across different screen resolutions.
    [*] Fix text scaling on the radial context menu.
    [*] Various minor map fixes, like fixing a few floating flowers.
    [*] Fixed a furniture duplication exploit.
    [*] Upgraded engine version, then undid the upgrade after finding it introduced new issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Verdant Skies 1.1! New Content!
notes.content:
This is the first big content patch, and it includes a new mining minigame, an auto-sprinkler, furniture flipping, and several dozen minor goodies. Without further ado, let's get to the list:

[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New mining drill. Begin this quest by talking to Miles after you've gotten pretty far in the game.
[*] Added the Auto-Sprinkler! Begin the quest by entering Sasha's house late in the game.
[*] New relationship window! See your relationship status with everyone at a glance. Also see their collections from anywhere in the game.
[/list]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now flip furniture left-to-right!
[*] Big improvements to pathfinding, especially for people getting stuck on animal pens.
[*] Show progress on the "Date 7 people at once" achievement.
[*] Show items that have already been crafted, like the tools.
[*] Wood storage boxes may be recolored.
[*] Replace "???" on the journal screen to clarify options.
[*] Add item names to the Collection UI.
[*] You may now remove a field with nothing planted in it.
[*] New accessibility option to remove audio muffling effects, like when you're low on energy.
[*] The cow is a little smaller so it is happier in the animal pen.
[*] Improve coloring of furniture as you try to place it.
[*] Support for 5:4 displays in the genetic splicer!
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new "simple circuit" is now required by simpler machines instead of the processor unit.
[*] All the watering animations are a bit faster.
[*] Increase gem drop rate out of purple mining nodes.
[*] Rebalance cooking times, most cooking times are about halved.
[*] Clay pots are worth a little more. 
[*] Animal incubator takes only one sapphire to construct.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The journal can now move you from "dating" to moved in or married. (in certain cases for certain characters, you could get stuck in the dating phase)
[*] Fix saves where Skye couldn't be unlocked.
[*] Fix a rare watering quest bug that occurs when it rains.
[*] Mining uses hammer artwork and the hammer tool's upgrade state.
[*] Fix controller support for some insect gathering interfaces.
[*] Colliders around the shopping tables are no longer weird.
[*] Potted plants can now be deconstructed properly.
[*] Fix some unsightly seams and sorting issues, especially in the mountain.
[*] Hide the character's nose when you're wearing a helmet.
[*] Fix many minor dialog issues.
[*] Fix potential performance issues in the genetic splicer.
[*] Fix a potential issue with animal pen and splicer not unlocking.
[*] People you've met for the first time will no longer congratulate you on your wedding.
[*] Minor map improvements, fixed some roads and misc misplaced items.
[/list]

[h1]Misc:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Transitioned project to a new git repository to make development easier. This cut about 6 GB off the project size!
[*] Upgrade game engine to a newer version.
[*] Game ships with pdb files to help modders.
[/list]

notes.title: Verdant Skies 1.1! New Content!
notes.content:
This is the first big content patch, and it includes a new mining minigame, an auto-sprinkler, furniture flipping, and several dozen minor goodies. Without further ado, let's get to the list:

[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New mining drill. Begin this quest by talking to Miles after you've gotten pretty far in the game.
[*] Added the Auto-Sprinkler! Begin the quest by entering Sasha's house late in the game.
[*] New relationship window! See your relationship status with everyone at a glance. Also see their collections from anywhere in the game.
[/list]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now flip furniture left-to-right!
[*] Big improvements to pathfinding, especially for people getting stuck on animal pens.
[*] Show progress on the "Date 7 people at once" achievement.
[*] Show items that have already been crafted, like the tools.
[*] Wood storage boxes may be recolored.
[*] Replace "???" on the journal screen to clarify options.
[*] Add item names to the Collection UI.
[*] You may now remove a field with nothing planted in it.
[*] New accessibility option to remove audio muffling effects, like when you're low on energy.
[*] The cow is a little smaller so it is happier in the animal pen.
[*] Improve coloring of furniture as you try to place it.
[*] Support for 5:4 displays in the genetic splicer!
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new "simple circuit" is now required by simpler machines instead of the processor unit.
[*] All the watering animations are a bit faster.
[*] Increase gem drop rate out of purple mining nodes.
[*] Rebalance cooking times, most cooking times are about halved.
[*] Clay pots are worth a little more. 
[*] Animal incubator takes only one sapphire to construct.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The journal can now move you from "dating" to moved in or married. (in certain cases for certain characters, you could get stuck in the dating phase)
[*] Fix saves where Skye couldn't be unlocked.
[*] Fix a rare watering quest bug that occurs when it rains.
[*] Mining uses hammer artwork and the hammer tool's upgrade state.
[*] Fix controller support for some insect gathering interfaces.
[*] Colliders around the shopping tables are no longer weird.
[*] Potted plants can now be deconstructed properly.
[*] Fix some unsightly seams and sorting issues, especially in the mountain.
[*] Hide the character's nose when you're wearing a helmet.
[*] Fix many minor dialog issues.
[*] Fix potential performance issues in the genetic splicer.
[*] Fix a potential issue with animal pen and splicer not unlocking.
[*] People you've met for the first time will no longer congratulate you on your wedding.
[*] Minor map improvements, fixed some roads and misc misplaced items.
[/list]

[h1]Misc:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Transitioned project to a new git repository to make development easier. This cut about 6 GB off the project size!
[*] Upgrade game engine to a newer version.
[*] Game ships with pdb files to help modders.
[/list]

notes.title: Verdant Skies - Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[H1]Release Date Announcement![/H1]
It’s been a busy month, but we’re thrilled to announce our release date of February 12th. We were hoping to have everything finished by the end of January, but we needed a little more time to make sure we give you the best experience possible at release. The biggest time sink has been getting meaningful daily dialogs written for all of the characters, and that’s the main thing we’re still finishing up. Sorry to disappoint everyone with the slight delay, but it’ll be worth it!


If you’ve already purchased Verdant Skies through our Humble Bundle widget, thank you! Your key will arrive a few days before launch so you can pre-load the game on your computer. It will unlock when it’s live on Steam!

[H1]New Website and Wiki[/H1]
We’ve upgraded our website with a cleaner look and more intuitive interactions. It’s one of those things you do when your game is about to be released! Thanks to the folks over at Gamepedia, we also have a wiki: [URL=https://verdantskies.gamepedia.com/]https://verdantskies.gamepedia.com/[/URL] They’re already filling it in, so if you’re worried about spoilers, don’t browse too deeply!

We just started a discussion forum on Steam. If you’ve got questions or comments, that’s a great place to ask: [URL=http://steamcommunity.com/app/730050/discussions/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/730050/discussions/[/URL]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/e4ab2f45fb06a52f033edc94ba839942264a2c3b.png[/img]

[H1]Mountain Crops[/H1]
The mountain crops are the most challenging to grow, since they require unlocking the mountain region and having the tier 3 tools. But the more difficult crops have a higher base price, and having access to all 14 crops will allow you to make the most complex recipes that restore the most energy.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/c8b656c72a9d2a47ffd66394d2d9a85120d135cb.png[/img]

[H1]Pair Events and Other Romances[/H1]
We’ve been writing events that occur between two characters once you’ve reached a certain friendship level with both of them. These have been a lot of fun to write, since the player gets to see their differing personality traits interact. Not all of these events are romantic, but if you’re not dating either of those characters, they might start expressing interest in eachother!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/ada32d9f00551e552259a018de7da1a301f96fb6.jpg[/img]

[H1]Followup Dialog[/H1]
To make the characters seem even more alive, certain events have followup dialog. Especially useful when an event didn’t include the player, the followups allow the NPC to confide with the player and share some extra details about the person they were just talking to.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/ada32d9f00551e552259a018de7da1a301f96fb6.jpg[/img]

[H1]End Game Content[/H1]
In addition to the blueprints you can unlock through the Planetary Pioneer blueprint system, there are some even more advanced blueprints to unlock through character events. They’re tough to make, but offer some nice boosts once you’ve established yourself in the colony.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/e7ccbd15cc3f7581821f136f826ee06a58e0c626.png[/img]

[H1]Finalized Sprites[/H1]
In the last newsletter we showed you a few stills from our new NPC animations. Here’s the full lineup of colonists on Viridis Primus! You’ve met most of them, but there’s a few we just didn’t have time to introduce.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/1a7d8c18ddc97e2905e582cd1b91882fd5c79ed7.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/505504ea5620acb760ccb4c5b255d837be9655f3.png[/img]

[H1]Introducing Nessa Collins[/H1]
Nessa Collins can be found flitting about her laboratory intensely studying samples from her menagerie. A talented zoologist with an interest in cloning, Nessa will help you improve the quality of your livestock products.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/6938f04a15e8d2459089ba7af86ebde2d5748085.png[/img]

notes.title: Verdant Skies - Final Stretch to Release!
notes.content:
[H1][B]Final Stretch![/B][/H1]
We're grateful to all of you folks who have been patiently waiting for our release! We haven't nailed down an exact date yet, but we're in the final phase of testing and clean up, so you should expect to see us on Steam sometime later this month or in early February. Thanks for your patience and engagement throughout the development process. You are why we do what we do!

The current count of lines of dialog: 37,862!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/4f6e892a3064a76529d379dd986a40f63b276e1d.jpg[/img]

[H1][B]New Machines[/B][/H1]
Sarah Seember Huisken has been at it again! Check out these gorgeous additions. The animal genetic splicer will function similarly to the crop genetic splicer (left). Once you get your ideal DNA sample you can bring your new animal to life in the animal incubator (right).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/17c114e8c1edb2e60bcf5a2c4b86b5a8f460a7b7.jpg[/img]

[H1][B]Marsh Crops[/B][/H1]
There are 14 different crops that grow in three different regions. It seems we haven't shared too many screenshots of them yet, so here are a few of the marsh crops!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/fee0614d445c076aad738cc6e5f4e90fda9633c4.png[/img]

[H1][B]New NPC Animations[/B][/H1]
We've had the chance to work with a group of very talented local artists while making Verdant Skies. The most recent is Ethan Calabria who jumped in to finish the NPC sprite walking cycle animations.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/6614a0199fa18124db9cfca83986767302d2717f.jpg[/img]

We're still making minor adjustments to the facial features, so these aren't exactly what you'll see in game. Once we've settled on the style of eyes, nose, and mouth that we wish to use, we'll give all the NPCs a more uniform appearance.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/dffd2e2ccd50f4493df3ddefd47f53182fefcd0c.jpg[/img]

[H1][B]UI Updates[/B][/H1]
Andy's been working hard to make sure that the in game user interface (UI) is uniform and streamlined. Here's a peek at the progress he's made on the achievement panel where players can track their achievement progress.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/64f7ea4a9a075b7a9d77da25cd5b11faa9285ddc.jpg[/img]

[H1][B]Introducing Ramón Martínez[/B][/H1]
Space travel is not something Ramón Martínez would have ever considered if it weren't for his twin sister, Rosie. Though risk-averse, Ramón could not refuse her request to serve as the colony's nurse. Always the overprotective brother, Ramón spends most of his time watching over Rosie... Whether she likes it or not.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/c1a465f5a3b0c16d18921331af171aa2b664babf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Verdant Skies December - Relationship Update
notes.content:
[H1]Making New Friends[/H1]
As you build your colony on Viridis Primus, you’ll also be building relationships with your fellow colonists. Today we’ll explore some of the technical and creative tricks we use to craft the immersive narrative in Verdant Skies. We’ll also give you an update on our Steam integration progress and reveal another NPC.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/7eb9b0e812cb72181c1b3bd0db5a4c1a1befb539.gif[/img]

[H1]Steam Integration[/H1]
Once you’ve got a Steam page set up, you need to integrate the Steam library into your game. We’re working on support for Steam achievements, cloud saves, and the steam workshop. Scott ( @slembcke ) is helping out with the integration, and so far we’ve got the game launching with the library activated and the Steam overlay showing up. Achievements are unlocking, so the rest of the Steam features should be wrapped up soon!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/3694635e293a14d5e42e6608f9f59c69d829f599.jpg[/img]

[H1]Relationship Progression[/H1]
Like many games in the life simulation genre, Verdant Skies offers you an opportunity to befriend and romance a set of non-player characters (NPCs). There are 12 NPCs in your colony. Any player can date all of them… in one play through.

Your relationship progression is tracked with a bar and a set of 9 hearts which appear at the bottom of the NPC dialogue box. The bar fills as you complete collection events and speak to your potential mates. Answering their questions in a favorable way can award bonus points towards achieving the next heart event. However, answering in a negative manner can decrease your relationship points. So listen carefully to what people have to say to ensure you don’t offend them!

The first 6 events for all characters are available regardless of if you choose to date someone. Events 7-9 are accessible once you have elected to date that NPC. Some of the colonists require exclusive dating, while others are willing to let you explore relationships with multiple people at the same time before settling down.

Even if you decide to move in or take commitment vows with one NPC, the journal feature, which we discussed in our July newsletter, allows you to break up with your current significant other to pursue (or resume) a relationship with another.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/29ff31e5af3d47ef546a4872adfedca12e24f0f7.jpg[/img]

Friendship, Move In, Committed, and Baby badges. These appear in place of the hearts in dialogue boxes when you reach these milestones with the colonists of Viridis Primus.

[H1]Branching Dialogues[/H1]
Depending on your previous choices, NPCs will react differently to you. Some decisions (like in the example below) are flagged and triggered within the same event. However, other decisions can have lasting effects. You may not immediately feel the impact of your decisions, but there are always repercussions.

We’re up to 35,000 lines of dialogue, but we’re not finished yet! Along with their 9 relationship events, each NPC also has daily dialogues that correspond to each level of your relationship.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/8862633837aed865db3bd6cd33aec3d4c03e3e00.jpg[/img]

[H1]Variables[/H1]
In order to make you feel like you’re a part of the colony, we use different variables to track player and NPC names. Depending on your level of friendship, each NPC also may call you by a different nickname or pet name. They’ll also know if you’re already dating another colonist and will refer to them by name.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/d3d508125a4c71c1e0166bf67c4c591b3643656e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/c37150945392e9f74e960c55d3acfe025ff0064e.jpg[/img]

[H1]Introducing Doctor Zaheen Patel[/H1]
Colonists of Viridis Primus who fall ill will have the privilege of being treated by Doctor Zaheen Patel. Mindfully practicing medicine through a holistic approach, Zaheen is well liked by their patients. Zaheen’s presence in the colony is sure to help with morale due to their warm nature and conflict resolution skills.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/0152cf098abf74aad2a9fa871f97c0d41b7622bf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Verdant Skies November Development Update
notes.content:
[B]Steam Page is Live![/B]
Our Steam page is up! If you haven’t already, please follow, favorite, or wishlist your copy of Verdant Skies today!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/3cf237ed5adac45202597d301a93051d859576d9.jpg[/img]

[B]Eclipse Season[/B]
There may be four seasons on Earth, but there’s only two on Viridis Primus – Summer and Eclipse. No crops grow during the Eclipse season, giving you a chance to catch up with the other colonists. But don’t worry! Unlike winters on Earth, Eclipse season only lasts 5 days.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/e8eb46b4e6932f26aceb7b303ea866e46974ee9f.jpg[/img]

[B]New Icons[/B]
Here’s a few of our new cooking and tools icons, courtesy of Sarah Seember Huisken ( [URL]https://www.movieshouting.com/[/URL] ). There will be more to come as we continue to expand our crafting systems.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/1a6034588f783caf1e5c197ac29d3a16ffcfcb7c.jpg[/img]

[B]Customizable Furniture[/B]
Making your house feel like a home is hard work! Now you can change the color of the wood on your furniture to suit your style. Don’t worry about the high price tag! Once you purchase a stain color you may reuse it again and again.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/c9d8d2c8bc240ae0eac4452bf825d72155aa90ea.jpg[/img]

[B]A Curious Cave…[/B]
No mining will be happening in this cave. It’s far too small for you to squeeze inside! But a voice from the depths implores you… “bring snacks…” Can you decipher the mystery of the tiny cave to unlock a special item?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/d6a320294926fa2404593d21d51de2fe9214e9fd.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/f709c4df1c8848d34374e1effa7b1c6c318f35e7.jpg[/img]

[B]Introducing Skye Miller![/B]
Despite being paid by Planetary Pioneers, Skye takes seriously her ethical responsibility to produce an unbiased narrative of the colonization of Viridis Primus. Her desire for an honest representation sometimes puts her at odds with Jade who would prefer a more positive spin on the colony’s progress.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/d8ea8cfdb272680e1be35f5a8f5b306742ad644e.png[/img]

[B]Winter Is Coming[/B]
As the cold weather moves into the Midwest, it’s the perfect time of year for game development. We’re definitely not going into hibernation over the holiday season! In fact, you can look forward to two developer updates in the month of December.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31065354/24143c48035fe9330378c3501c6d08af737942ef.jpg[/img]
